contexts.text: The priest preached a discourse full of wisdom... The sermon was about...
The devil said... I can also preach, and I have preached too, I asked, What hast thou preached?
When a priest is preaching from zeal...
They believe that when they are preaching from zeal, they are inspired...
If this hypocrite becomes a preacher...
Then, what the preacher presents, is mere sound...
Listen to the preachings in the temples.
There is no more spirituality in their sermons...
A certain stupid one... who at certain times as it were preached.
He was reduced into the state of zeal which he had in preachings...
As they do in preachings who praise the preaching...

All theological preachers are ignorant of the falsities of their own religion; for they preach that there is one God... and, then, do not remember anything about three Gods, etc... But the falsity imbibed in the schools adheres within, and the other things are solely in the mouth; and after death they will come into the interiors of the spirit...
